description:
The Vilano Step Through City Bike 7 Speed Hybrid Urban Retro Commuter is the perfect city, commuter and town bike! Speedy 700c wheels with 700c x 35c tires for comfortable handling. The sturdy steel frame has water bottle mounts. This bike is an excellent choice for errands, commuting and weekend trips! Jump on and off this simple bike easily with the step thru frame. Ride upright with the classic-look hybrid/cruiser handlebars. The matching suspension saddle and comfortable grips are stylish. Water bottle mounts on the sturdy hi-ten steel frame. Twist grip shifter controls 7 gears. One size frame, 50cm, suggested rider height over 5’4″, bike is appropriate for adult riders.

Bike is shipped factory direct. Assembly & Tuning are Required. Pedal installation can be tricky, please follow included directions closely.
